title: Roots Expanded
description: Roots Expanded is a small vanilla inspired modpack that expands on the base game just enough to keep things fresh without losing that classic Minecraft feel. Early version built for a small group of friends so don't expect anything major!
body:
![Roots Expanded Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50d21b45399978ebb1fb38430263649c218349ed.png)
=========================================================================================
Roots Expanded is a small, vanilla-inspired modpack that takes everything you love about Minecraft and expands on it just enough to keep things feeling fresh and exciting, without straying too far from the classic experience you know and love.
This pack adds a handful of new content, quality of life improvements, and small tweaks that enhance the game while staying true to its roots. Whether you're building, exploring, or surviving, Roots Expanded aims to make the experience just a little bit better without overwhelming you with changes.
Please keep in mind that this is a very early version of the pack, originally built for a small group of friends. Don't expect anything massive — this is a passion project that will continue to grow and improve over time. Thank you.
